title: Trigger an event with another button (Resolved)

posts.author: Jay19
posts.body:
Hello,
I'd like to know if it's possible to trigger an event with a button other than the action button.
The idea is to use the mini-game Tiple Triad created by Raizen, which is the card game from Final Fantasy VIII.
In FF8, you could press "X" to talk to an NPC, or press "Square" to challenge them to a card game.
In RPG Maker, the closest solution I've found is to explain to the player that they should hold down the "Square" button before talking to the NPC. And I could add on each NPC: If the Shift key is pressed, then the mini-game is launched, then the "end" label is displayed, which I'll place at the end of the event.
But it would be easier to be able to trigger the event directly with the Shift button. Is there a plugin capable of doing this?
Thanks to anyone who can help me ^^

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
You can put the card gaming NPCs to parallel and check if player is next to them and player is facing them and conditionals if player is pressing a certain button. Then have the event turn toward player and do different stuff depending on the conditionals (or turn them to a different page
if you want to stop autonomous movement for other events
, and afterward turn page back).
EDIT: Hmmm, did I confuse what movement stops during dialogues...anyway the point of my reply still stands LOL

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
there are plugins with label triggers.
